zh.description: RustFS 是一个使用 Rust 构建的高性能 S3 兼容对象存储系统，提供分布式存储能力，支持多卷存储。

name: Syncthing
description: Continuous peer-to-peer file synchronization with a browser-based administration interface.

zh.description: Syncthing 是持续运行的点对点文件同步工具，提供浏览器管理界面。

name: tModLoader
description: Host a modded Terraria server with Steam Workshop mods, persistent worlds, scheduled saves, and password-protected multiplayer.

zh.description: 托管支持 Steam 创意工坊模组、持久化世界、定时存档和密码保护联机的 Terraria 模组服务器。

name: TrendRadar
description: TrendRadar tracks trending topics, generates reports, and serves the latest HTML report through a built-in web server.

zh.description: TrendRadar 用于追踪热点话题、生成趋势报告，并通过内置 Web 服务展示最新 HTML 报告。

name: Tududi
description: Tududi is a self-hosted productivity app for managing tasks, projects, notes, areas, and personal workflows.

zh.description: Tududi 是一款自托管效率工具，用于管理任务、项目、笔记、领域和个人工作流。

name: TYPO3
description: Open-source enterprise content management system for building and managing websites.

zh.description: 开源企业级内容管理系统，用于构建和管理网站。

name: Vane (Perplexica)
description: Vane, formerly Perplexica, is a privacy-focused AI answering engine with cited web search, file analysis, and local conversation history.

zh.description: Vane（原 Perplexica）是一款注重隐私的 AI 问答引擎，支持带引用的网页搜索、文件分析和本地会话历史。

name: WooCommerce
description: Launch WooCommerce with WordPress on Sealos. The template installs the store plugin and provisions MySQL, persistent site storage, and HTTPS access.

zh.description: WooCommerce 是基于 WordPress 的开源电商平台。

name: 7 Days to Die
description: A private 7 Days to Die dedicated server with persistent saves, LinuxGSM management, and native TCP/UDP access.

zh.description: 自托管 7 Days to Die 专用服务器，提供持久化存档、LinuxGSM 管理和原生 TCP/UDP 访问。

name: Agora Token Service
description: Agora Token Service for generating RTC and RTM tokens to authenticate users before they access the Agora service or join an RTC channel

zh.description: Agora Token 服务用于生成 RTC 和 RTM Token，在用户访问 Agora 服务或加入 RTC 频道之前进行身份验证

name: anki-sync-server
description: Host your own Anki sync endpoint on Sealos. Configure compatible Anki clients to synchronize study collections with the server you operate.

zh.description: anki-sync-server 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的自托管开源工具，适合团队协作、内部流程和日常生产力场景。

name: Apache Superset
description: Modern data exploration and visualization platform for dashboards, charts, and SQL analytics.

zh.description: 现代化数据探索与可视化平台，用于仪表盘、图表和 SQL 分析。

name: APITable
description: Open-source API-oriented spreadsheet and collaborative database platform for building no-code data apps.

zh.description: APITable 是开源的 API 优先协作表格和数据库平台，可用于搭建无代码数据应用。

name: chatany
description: Deploy ChatAny's AI chat and image-service interface on Sealos using your provider credentials. Upstream development has stopped; assess maintenance before adoption.

zh.description: chatany 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的自托管 AI 应用，适合模型工作流、智能助手和团队实验环境。

name: FileCodeBox
description: Lightweight anonymous text and file sharing service with access codes, admin management, and optional S3-compatible storage.

zh.description: 轻量级匿名文本和文件分享服务，支持提取码、管理后台和可选 S3 兼容存储。

name: Gitea
description: A lightweight, self-hosted Git service with code hosting, review, package registry, and CI/CD features.

zh.description: 一款轻量的自托管 Git 服务，提供代码托管、代码审查、软件包仓库和 CI/CD 功能。

name: GLPI
description: Manage IT assets and service desk requests with GLPI on Sealos, backed by a dedicated MySQL database, persistent storage, and a public HTTPS endpoint.

zh.description: GLPI 是一个开源的 IT 资产管理和服务台平台。

name: InsForge
description: InsForge is the Agent-Native Supabase Alternative, enabling AI agents to build and manage full-stack applications autonomously.

zh.description: InsForge 是面向 AI 编码代理的后端平台替代方案，支持数据库、认证、存储与函数能力的一体化部署。

name: IT-Tools
description: Host IT-Tools on Sealos to give your team a browser-based collection of development and IT utilities. Access the tools from a dedicated HTTPS address.

zh.description: IT-Tools 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的自托管开源工具，适合团队协作、内部流程和日常生产力场景。

name: jsoncrack
description: JSON Crack is a free, open-source data visualization app capable of visualizing data formats such as JSON, YAML, XML, CSV and more, into interactive graphs.

zh.description: jsoncrack 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的自托管开源工具，适合团队协作、内部流程和日常生产力场景。

name: Loki
description: Loki is a horizontally scalable, highly available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus.

zh.description: Loki 是一个水平可扩展、高可用、多租户的日志聚合系统，灵感来自 Prometheus。

name: Mage AI
description: Build, schedule, and monitor data pipelines with Mage AI on Sealos. Use a notebook-style editor with PostgreSQL metadata and persistent project files.

zh.description: 开源数据流水线工具，用于构建与运行数据工作流。

name: MarkItDown MCP
description: The official MarkItDown MCP server exposes document-to-Markdown conversion through Streamable HTTP and SSE.

zh.description: 官方 MarkItDown MCP 服务通过 Streamable HTTP 和 SSE 提供文档转 Markdown 能力。

name: MAZANOKE
description: Self-hosted local image optimizer that runs in your browser and keeps images on your device.

zh.description: 在浏览器中运行的自托管本地图片优化工具，图片保留在用户设备上处理。

name: Meilisearch
description: A fast, open-source search engine API with a lightweight web dashboard for managing indexes, documents, and search settings.

zh.description: 快速、开源的搜索引擎 API，并带有轻量 Web 管理界面，可管理索引、文档和搜索设置。

name: MinIO
description: MinIO is a High Performance Object Storage released under GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. It is API compatible with Amazon S3 cloud storage service. Use MinIO to build high performance infrastructure for machine learning, analytics and application data workloads.

zh.description: MinIO 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的存储服务，适合文件、对象数据和应用资产管理。

name: Nakama Server
description: Nakama is an open-source game server for real-time multiplayer, social features, and live ops.

zh.description: Nakama 是一个开源的游戏开发平台，能自动处理用户登录、实时聊天、排行榜、成就系统，还能智能匹配玩家。

name: nanobot
description: A self-hosted AI agent with a browser workspace, persistent conversations, tools, memory, and scheduled tasks.

zh.description: 自托管 AI 智能体，提供浏览器工作台、持久化对话、工具调用、记忆和定时任务。

name: NetBird
description: A self-hosted WireGuard-based zero-trust networking platform with management, signaling, relay, and an embedded identity provider.

zh.description: 基于 WireGuard 的零信任网络平台，支持自托管管理、信令与中继。

name: Node-RED
description: Connect devices, APIs, and services in Node-RED's visual flow editor on Sealos. Keep flows and credentials on persistent storage and access the editor over HTTPS.

zh.description: 面向事件驱动应用的低代码编程平台。

name: Odysseus
description: Odysseus is a self-hosted AI workspace with chat, deep research, memory, skills, calendar, notes, and document tools.

zh.description: Odysseus 是自托管 AI 工作空间，支持聊天、深度研究、记忆、技能、日历、笔记和文档工具。

name: OpenAgents
description: AI Agent Networks for Open Collaboration. Create self-contained communities where agents discover peers, collaborate on problems, and grow together. Protocol-agnostic, works with popular LLM providers and agent frameworks.

zh.description: AI 智能体网络平台,用于开放协作。创建独立的社区,让智能体发现同伴、协作解决问题并共同成长。协议无关,支持主流 LLM 提供商和智能体框架。

name: OpenHands
description: AI software development agent web app for editing code, running commands, and automating development tasks.

zh.description: AI 软件开发代理 Web 应用，用于编辑代码、运行命令和自动化开发任务。

name: PalaCMS
description: PalaCMS is a modern content management system built for developers and content creators

zh.description: PalaCMS 是一个为开发者和内容创作者构建的现代内容管理系统

name: Paperless-ngx
description: Paperless-ngx is a community-supported open-source document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive so you can keep, well, less paper.

zh.description: Paperless-ngx 是一个社区支持的开源文档管理系统，可以将您的纸质文档转换为可搜索的在线档案，让您减少纸张使用。

name: Payload
description: Payload is a Next.js native CMS with an extensible admin panel, REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication, and media management.

zh.description: Payload 是一个原生集成 Next.js 的开源 CMS，提供可扩展管理后台、REST 与 GraphQL API、认证和媒体管理能力。

name: PDFMathTranslate
description: Translate scientific PDFs with PDFMathTranslate on Sealos while preserving formulas and layout. Use a password-protected WebUI with persistent files and caches.

zh.description: 翻译科研 PDF，并尽可能保留公式、表格和页面排版。

name: Presenton
description: Open-source AI presentation generator and API with self-hosted model, image, template, and export controls.

zh.description: 开源 AI 演示文稿生成器和 API，支持自托管模型、图像生成、模板与导出控制。

name: PrestaShop
description: Open-source e-commerce platform for building customizable online stores, catalogs, carts, checkout flows, and merchant back offices.

zh.description: 开源电商平台，用于构建可定制的在线商店、商品目录、购物车、结账流程和商家后台。

name: Project Quay
description: Host an OCI container registry with Project Quay on Sealos. Store images with PostgreSQL, Redis, persistent storage, and automatic initial administrator setup.

zh.description: 用于构建、存储和分发容器镜像的企业级容器镜像仓库。

name: Project Zomboid
description: Host a persistent Project Zomboid dedicated server with Steam multiplayer, private worlds, and RCON administration.

zh.description: 部署持久化 Project Zomboid 专用服务器，支持 Steam 多人联机、私人世界和 RCON 管理。

name: Ruiqi-Waf
description: A modern web application firewall (WAF) management system built on top of HAProxy and OWASP Coraza WAF with the Coraza SPOA integration. This system provides a comprehensive backend API for managing HAProxy configurations, Coraza WAF rules, and traffic inspection.

zh.description: Ruiqi-Waf 是一款可在 Sealos 上一键部署的 DevOps 工具，适合平台运维、发布流程和基础设施管理。

name: Samarium
description: Samarium is an open-source Laravel ERP and CMS for inventory, sales, purchases, accounting, pages, and customer operations.

zh.description: Samarium 是一个基于 Laravel 的开源 ERP 与 CMS，适用于库存、销售、采购、会计、内容页面和客户运营管理。

name: Stirling-PDF
description: A self-hosted PDF toolbox for merging, splitting, conversion, OCR, compression, redaction, and other document workflows.

zh.description: 一个自托管 PDF 工具箱，支持合并、拆分、转换、OCR、压缩、涂黑和其他文档处理流程。

name: Strapi
description: Open-source headless CMS for building customizable content APIs and administration workflows.

zh.description: 用于构建可定制内容 API 和管理工作流的开源无头内容管理系统。

name: TradingAgents
description: Multi-agent LLM financial trading research framework with a browser launcher for ticker analysis.

zh.description: TradingAgents 是多智能体大模型金融交易研究框架，此模板提供浏览器入口用于启动股票分析。

name: Twenty
description: Open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce. Customizable views, flexible data management, workflow automation. Built with TypeScript, React, NestJS, PostgreSQL.

zh.description: Salesforce 的开源替代品。支持自定义视图（看板/表格）、灵活的数据管理、工作流自动化。基于 TypeScript、React、NestJS、PostgreSQL 构建。

name: Typesense
description: A modern, open-source search engine alternative to Algolia and an easier-to-use alternative to Elasticsearch.

zh.description: 现代化、开源的搜索引擎，可作为 Algolia 的替代方案，比 Elasticsearch 更易用。

name: Valheim Docker
description: A persistent Valheim dedicated server with the built-in Huginn status dashboard and Steam multiplayer support.

zh.description: 提供持久化世界存档、内置 Huginn 状态面板与 Steam 多人游戏支持的 Valheim 专用服务器。

name: ZITADEL
description: Open-source identity and access management platform for authentication and authorization.

zh.description: 开源身份与访问管理平台，提供认证与授权能力。
